page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-16 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the AMD EPYC 7B13 processor. It features 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 64 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In performance evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, scoring in the top 25% on stress-ng single-core benchmarks. Multi-core and memory performance metrics generally fall within the average range. This includes average scores for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench single-core and multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is measured at 1013.33 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 93.7 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

Given its balanced resource distribution and average multi-threaded performance, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads. These include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and text processing. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource sharing, making it a reliable option for standard enterprise applications.
